chunks: 3767 - And in another narration, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Ribāṭ, from one who narrated it, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If an animal is afflicted by an occurrence within three days, then it is from the seller’s property liability."

key_terms.الْبَائِعِ: the seller who bears liability in this case
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ: the three-day period relevant to the ruling
key_terms.حَدَثٌ: an occurrence, defect, or incident affecting the item

ai.seo_question: Who bears the loss if an animal develops a defect within three days of sale in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in sales involving animals. If a defect or harmful occurrence affects the animal within three days, the loss is borne by the seller rather than the buyer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3767 - In another narration, Ibn Faddal narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Ribbat, from someone who narrated it from Abu Abdillah (as), who said:
"If an animal develops a defect within three days, it is the responsibility of the seller."
